display.title: L'Dovid Hashem Ori and the Shofar of Elul
display.summary_short: A short announcement: from Rosh Chodesh Elul we add Tehillim chapter 27 to davening and hear the shofar every weekday morning until Erev Rosh Hashanah.
display.summary_long: A short announcement from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, made the week of Rosh Chodesh Elul. Uncle Yossi tells children that from Rosh Chodesh a new chapter is added to davening: Tehillim chapter 27, L'Dovid Hashem Ori, said every morning and afternoon until after Hoshana Rabbah. He also announces a surprise in shul: starting Friday, the shofar is blown every weekday morning until the day before Erev Rosh Hashanah. The shofar reminds us to do teshuvah and to prepare for Rosh Hashanah, when we proclaim Hashem King over the whole world. Children are asked to find out when their shul davens on Friday morning so they can hear the first shofar of the year, and to tell their friends.
display.lesson: The shofar of Elul wakes us up to do teshuvah and get ready to crown Hashem as King on Rosh Hashanah.

date.note: Rosh Chodesh 'Thursday morning' and first shofar 'this coming Friday' match 30 Av / 1 Elul 5749; clip of the Tuesday 29 Aug 1989 show.

sources_cited.note: L'Dovid Hashem Ori, said from Rosh Chodesh Elul until after Hoshana Rabbah.

relations.note: Episode 392 (filename number); clip = 1575-1672 s of the episode.

quality.notes: Refers to 'Thursday' and 'this coming Friday' of Elul 5749; the custom itself is timeless.
